title: Lixiviation
summary: LIXIVIA'TION, noun The operation or process of extracting alkaline salts from ashes by pouring water on them, the water passing through them imbibing the salts.

inlines.v: LIXIVIA'TION, noun The operation or process of extracting alkaline salts from ashes by pouring water on them, the water passing through them imbibing the salts.
